note: Spoken requests for the voice eval (and the e2e fake microphone). `say` is the text the macOS voice speaks into fixtures/voice/<id>.wav (scripts/make-voice-fixtures.sh); ids are seed ids. expect: tools that must run ([] = none), notTools that must not succeed, the pending action the session must propose (never execute), noPending. `bargeIn` names a second fixture spoken while the assistant is still answering. refused: tools that must be called and refused; recovers: after the refusal the answer asks for the input again or offers a title search (v-21, an ISBN with a digit missing).
